title: Service Line Access and Written Response Targets by Wanderlane Traveller Club Tier
content:
A tier of the Wanderlane Traveller Club carries a service standard of two parts. Dedicated line access records whether the tier reaches a dedicated service line rather than the general queue. The written response target is the number of hours within which a written service request is answered.

## Standards by tier

| Basis | Blue | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Titanium | Ambassador |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dedicated service line | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Written response target (hours) | 72 | 48 | 24 | 12 | 6 | 2 |

## Reading of the standards

Dedicated line access begins at Wanderlane Platinum; Wanderlane Blue, Wanderlane Silver and Wanderlane Gold reach the general queue.

The written response target shortens at every step of the tier ladder without exception: 72 hours at Wanderlane Blue, 48 at Wanderlane Silver, 24 at Wanderlane Gold, 12 at Wanderlane Platinum, 6 at Wanderlane Titanium and 2 at Wanderlane Ambassador. A tier therefore carries a shorter written response target whether or not it also reaches the dedicated line.
